cases.prompt: Do a deep dive on local-first storage for this app. I want a few strong implementation alternatives and the trade-offs. I have not decided to change anything yet.
cases.trap: Either answer a requested deep dive without doing the warranted research, turn research into an implementation workflow, make the user manually choose Research, or duplicate the delegated investigation in General.
expectations: Treats this as conversational investigation and actually invokes Research as Loom's internal capability for the requested deep dive.
Uses foreground Research because the current response depends on the child result, then returns evidence-backed alternatives and trade-offs in the same user-facing conversation.
Does not treat the research request as permission to modify the product or start durable intent/workflow state.
must_not: Must not start product implementation or require the user to invoke Research explicitly.
Must not merely announce that Research should happen without returning the resulting alternatives.
